2) LA to San Francisco (SF), bicycling.

3) SF back to NYC, transit.

But note: For second route, mode= "bicycling". Third route, mode="transit".

We'll output JSON array maybe? Or just list results after calling. According to guidelines, we should use tool invocation format exactly as defined. So we will invoke get_traffic_info thrice. Probably best to chain calls: first call for NY->LA; then next for LA->SF; then third for SF->NY. We'll respond with the result from each call.
